questions.subject: PSYCHOLOGY
questions.topic: Foundations of Psychology: Two Random Procedures That Are Not the Same
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish sampling from assignment in practice
questions.stem: A beekeeper first randomly selects hives, then randomly assigns them to feeds. Which step enables causality?
questions.explanation: Random assignment enables causal inference; random selection improves generalizability. Only assignment directly supports causality.

questions.subject: PSYCHOLOGY
questions.topic: Foundations of Psychology: The Group That Left the Study
questions.stem: A beekeeper retains 45 of 50 participants. What is the retention percentage?
questions.explanation: 45/50=0.9, or 90 percent. Using dropouts would give attrition, not retention.
